title: The Food They Heard Praising God

segments.text: The companions of the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, once sat eating a meal... and heard the food itself... worshipping.
segments._shot: warm simple meal setting in low dark glow, no candles as subject

segments.text: This is the miracle... of the tasbih.
segments.title: THE TASBIH

segments.text: First, one word. Tasbih means glorifying Allah... saying His praise, declaring His perfection. Muslims do it with the words subhanallah. And the companions... the people who lived alongside the Prophet, peace be upon him... knew that sound better than any sound on earth.
segments._shot: prayer beads in soft light, still

segments.text: Abdullah ibn Mas'ud... may Allah be pleased with him... one of those companions, tells it plainly. We considered miracles a blessing from Allah... he said... while you people consider them a warning. And then he remembered. We were with Allah's Messenger... and we heard the food glorifying Allah... while it was being eaten.
segments._shot: steam rising from food in warm low light

segments.text: And in the very same narration, he describes water flowing from between the Prophet's fingers... peace be upon him... when the water had all but run out. Two impossibilities... one sentence... recorded in the most authenticated hadith collection in Islam.
segments._shot: water trickling over stones, backlit, no hands

segments.text: Now here is what makes it more than a wonder. The Qur'an says... there is not a single thing except that it glorifies His praise... but you do not understand their glorification. Everything is already praising Him... the miracle was not that the food began. It is that, for a moment... they were allowed to hear it.
segments._shot: forest, water and sky wide shot in golden light

segments.text: You are surrounded by worship right now... every leaf, every stone, every drop. Creation never went silent. The question the miracle leaves behind is quieter... will you join in?
